aboutDetailed: I am a Computer Science Engineering student currently pursuing my B.Tech at Silver Oak University in Gujarat, India, following the completion of my Diploma in Computer Engineering. My journey revolves around project-based learning — turning concepts from algorithms, databases, web systems, and machine learning into working software.
